data.content_ref: inline:015994869366 is compatible with SRC_004 but in a strictly weaker way than it claims: process-tracing can detect whether the panel terminates its reasoning at checklist items or integrates them into a broader mental model, but this integration is itself consistent with a more sophisticated surface-correlation strategy, so process-tracing merely relocates the confound rather than resolving it. This is refuted if a process trace can uniquely decompose integrated reasoning into causal-structure inference versus correlation exploitation, distinguishing the two at the level of verbal protocol or response-time signature.
